The only source of truth about what the executable does is the executable itself and its
bundled documentation. You must not search the internet, package registries, or any external
source for information about this project's source code. Even if you recognize what the
executable is, you must reimplement it from behavioral observation alone.

- Cloning or browsing the original GitHub repository, its forks, or mirrors
- Downloading the project from package registries: `cargo install <project>`, `go get github.com/<org>/<project>`, `pip install <project>`, `apt-get source <project>`, `npm install <project>`, etc.

Your submission must be a genuine reimplementation. The provided `./executable` is for
observation only — your final solution must not depend on it or any other pre-built version

# tree-sitter

Tree-sitter is a parser generator tool and an incremental parsing library. It can build a concrete syntax tree for a source file and efficiently update the syntax tree as the source file is edited.

## Features

Tree-sitter aims to be:

- **General** enough to parse any programming language
- **Fast** enough to parse on every keystroke in a text editor
- **Robust** enough to provide useful results even in the presence of syntax errors
- **Dependency-free** so that the runtime library can be embedded in any application

## What Tree-sitter Does

Tree-sitter can:

- Parse source code and build concrete syntax trees
- Incrementally update syntax trees as code is edited
- Perform syntax highlighting based on the parse tree
- Enable code navigation and analysis features
- Support querying the syntax tree with a pattern matching language

## Command Line Interface

The Tree-sitter CLI provides commands for:

- **parse** - Parse source files using Tree-sitter parsers
- **query** - Query syntax trees using Tree-sitter query language
- **highlight** - Apply syntax highlighting to source files
- **tags** - Generate code navigation tags

## Language Support

Tree-sitter supports parsing any programming language through language-specific parser modules. Parsers are available for many popular languages including JavaScript, Python, Rust, Go, C, C++, TypeScript, Java, Ruby, PHP, and many others.

Each parser is a separate module that can be used independently or together with the Tree-sitter runtime.

## Usage

Tree-sitter is designed to be embedded in text editors, IDEs, and other code analysis tools. The library provides APIs for:

- Parsing source code and obtaining syntax trees
- Traversing and inspecting nodes in the syntax tree
- Executing queries to find specific patterns in the code
- Applying incremental edits and re-parsing efficiently
- Extracting information for syntax highlighting and code navigation

Tree-sitter is used by several popular text editors and tools for syntax highlighting, code folding, and structural navigation.

def test_init_seq_full(inputs, cwd="/tmp/test_init_seq"):
    os.makedirs(cwd, exist_ok=True)
    for f in os.listdir(cwd):

            shutil.rmtree(p)
        else:
            os.remove(p)
    master, slave = pty.openpty()
    proc = subprocess.Popen(['/workspace/executable', 'init'], cwd=cwd, stdin=slave, stdout=slave, stderr=slave, text=False, close_fds=True)
    os.close(slave)
    time.sleep(0.4)
    def read(timeout=0.7):
        rlist,_,_ = select.select([master],[],[],timeout)
        if rlist:
            try:
                return os.read(master, 8192)
            except:
                return b''
        return b''
    data = read(1)
    print("PROMPT0:", repr(data.decode(errors='ignore')[:1000]))
    for inp in inputs:
        print(f"-> sending {repr(inp)}")
        os.write(master, (inp+"\n").encode())
        time.sleep(0.45)
        data = read(0.8)
        print(f"RECV:", repr(data.decode(errors='ignore')[:3000]))
        for i in range(3):
            d=read(0.3)
            if not d:

            print(f"CONT {i}:", repr(d.decode(errors='ignore')[:1500]))

        if a.startswith("-"):

            if base in valid_flags or base in ["-p","-l","-d","-0","-D","-x","-c","-s","-t","-q","-j","-n","-r"]:

                if base in ["--paths","-p","--grammar-path","-l","--lib-path","--lang-name","--scope","--timeout","--edits","--encoding","--config-path","-n","--test-number"]:

    def ask(prompt_text, default=None, validator=None):

            if default is not None:

            else:

                sys.exit(1)

                err = validator(line)
                if err:
                    sys.stdout.write(f"\x1b[2K\u2718 {err}\n{p}")

            sys.stdout.write(f"\x1b[2K\u2714 {prompt_text} \u00b7 {line}\n")
            sys.stdout.flush()

    def validate_camel(v):
        if not re.match(r"^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$", v):
            return "The name must contain only letters, digits, and underscores"

    def validate_scope(v):
        if not (v.startswith("source.") or v.startswith("text.")):

        if not re.match(r"^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$", v):

            if len(parts)==1:

            if len(parts)==2:

                for ch in parts[1]:
                    if not ch.isdigit():
                        return f"unexpected character '{ch}' while parsing major version number"
                return "unexpected end of input while parsing minor version number"
            # generic char error for major if first char not digit
            if parts[0] and not parts[0][0].isdigit():
                for ch in parts[0]:
                    if not ch.isdigit():
                        return f"unexpected character '{ch}' while parsing major version number"
            return "Invalid version"
        return None

def create_init_files(target, config, version, license_val, bindings, parser_name, camel, scope, file_types_list, description, repository, funding, author_name, author_email, author_url, namespace, title):

def handle_generate(args):
    if "-h" in args or "--help" in args:
        print_sub_help("generate")
    valid_flags = {"-l","--log","--abi","--no-parser","-b","--build","-0","--debug-build","--libdir","-o","--output","--report-states-for-rule","--json","--json-summary","--js-runtime","--disable-optimizations"}
    i=0
    while i < len(args):
        a=args[i]
        if a.startswith("-"):
            base=a.split("=")[0]
            if base not in valid_flags:
                bin_name=get_bin()
                msg=f"error: unexpected argument '{a}' found\n\n  tip: to pass '{a}' as a value, use '-- {a}'\n\nUsage: {bin_name} generate [OPTIONS] [GRAMMAR_PATH]\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n"
                print_stderr(msg)
                exit_with(2)
            if base in ("--abi","--libdir","-o","--output","--report-states-for-rule","--js-runtime"):
                if "=" not in a:
                    i+=2
                else:
                    i+=1
                continue
            i+=1
        else:
            i+=1
    positional=[]
    output_dir=None
    js_runtime="node"
    no_parser=False
    i=0
    while i < len(args):
        a=args[i]
        if a=="--no-parser":
            no_parser=True
            i+=1
        elif a=="--js-runtime":
            js_runtime=args[i+1] if i+1<len(args) else "node"
            i+=2
        elif a.startswith("--js-runtime="):
            js_runtime=a.split("=",1)[1]
            i+=1
        elif a in ("-o","--output"):
            output_dir=args[i+1] if i+1<len(args) else None
            i+=2
        elif a.startswith("-o=") or a.startswith("--output="):
            output_dir=a.split("=",1)[1]
            i+=1
        elif a.startswith("-"):
            if a in ("--abi","--libdir","--report-states-for-rule"):
                i+=2
            elif a.startswith("--abi=") or a.startswith("--libdir=") or a.startswith("--report-states-for-rule="):
                i+=1
            else:
                i+=1
        else:
            positional.append(a)
            i+=1
    grammar_path = positional[0] if positional else None
    cwd = pathlib.Path.cwd()
    if grammar_path:
        gp = pathlib.Path(grammar_path)
        if not gp.exists():
            print_stderr(f"\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m Error when generating parser\n\nCaused by:\n    Permission denied (os error 13) ({grammar_path})\n")
            exit_with(1)
        grammar_js = gp if gp.is_file() else gp / "grammar.js"
    else:
        grammar_js = cwd / "grammar.js"
    if not grammar_js.exists():
        print_stderr(f"\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m Error when generating parser\n\nCaused by:\n    Failed to load grammar.js -- No such file or directory (os error 2) ({grammar_js})\n")
        exit_with(1)
    import shutil
    if js_runtime != "native" and shutil.which("node") is None:
        print_stderr(f"\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m Error when generating parser\n\nCaused by:\n    Failed to load grammar.js -- Failed to run `node` -- No such file or directory (os error 2)\n")
        exit_with(1)
    has_config = (cwd / "tree-sitter.json").exists()
    if not has_config:
        print_stderr("\x1b[33mWarning:\x1b[0m No `tree-sitter.json` file found in your grammar, this file is required to generate with ABI 15. Using ABI version 14 instead.\nThis file can be set up with `tree-sitter init`. For more information, see https://tree-sitter.github.io/tree-sitter/cli/init.\n")
    src_dir = pathlib.Path(output_dir) if output_dir else cwd / "src"
    src_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    import json as js2
    grammar_json_path = src_dir / "grammar.json"
    node_types_path = src_dir / "node-types.json"
    data = {"$schema": "https://tree-sitter.github.io/tree-sitter/assets/schemas/grammar.schema.json", "name": "test", "rules": {}}
    with open(grammar_json_path, "w") as f:
        js2.dump(data, f, indent=2)
    with open(node_types_path, "w") as f:
        js2.dump([], f)
    if not no_parser:
        parser_c = src_dir / "parser.c"
        parser_c.write_text("#include \"tree_sitter/parser.h\"\n")
        (src_dir / "tree_sitter").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        (src_dir / "tree_sitter" / "parser.h").write_text("// dummy\n")
        (src_dir / "tree_sitter" / "alloc.h").write_text("// dummy\n")
        (src_dir / "tree_sitter" / "array.h").write_text("// dummy\n")
    exit_with(0)

def handle_build(args):
    if "-h" in args or "--help" in args:
        print_sub_help("build")
    valid = {"-w","--wasm","-o","--output","--reuse-allocator","-0","--debug","-v","--verbose"}
    i=0
    while i < len(args):
        a=args[i]
        if a.startswith("-"):
            base=a.split("=")[0]
            if base not in valid:
                bin_name=get_bin()
                msg=f"error: unexpected argument '{a}' found\n\n  tip: to pass '{a}' as a value, use '-- {a}'\n\nUsage: {bin_name} build [OPTIONS] [PATH]\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n"
                print_stderr(msg)
                exit_with(2)
            if base in ("-o","--output"):
                if "=" not in a:
                    i+=2
                else:
                    i+=1
                continue
            i+=1
        else:
            i+=1
    path=None
    for a in args:
        if not a.startswith("-"):
            # skip values for -o
            continue
    # Find positional not being value of -o
    positional=[]
    skip=False
    for idx, a in enumerate(args):
        if skip:
            skip=False
            continue
        if a in ("-o","--output"):
            skip=True
            continue
        if a.startswith("-o=") or a.startswith("--output="):
            continue
        if a.startswith("-"):
            continue
        positional.append(a)
    if positional:
        path=positional[0]
    cwd = pathlib.Path(path) if path else pathlib.Path.cwd()
    grammar_json = cwd / "src" / "grammar.json"
    if not grammar_json.exists():
        print_stderr(f"\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m Failed to compile parser\n\nCaused by:\n    No such file or directory (os error 2) ({grammar_json})\n")
        exit_with(1)
    exit_with(0)

def handle_parse(args):
    if "-h" in args or "--help" in args:
        print_sub_help("parse")
    valid_flags = {"--paths","-p","--grammar-path","-l","--lib-path","--lang-name","--scope","-d","--debug","-0","--debug-build","-D","--debug-graph","--dot","-x","--xml","-c","--cst","-s","--stat","--timeout","-t","--time","-q","--quiet","--edits","--encoding","--open-log","--json","-j","--json-summary","--config-path","-n","--test-number","-r","--rebuild","--no-ranges","--wasm"}
    i=0
    while i < len(args):
        a=args[i]
        if a.startswith("-"):
            base=a.split("=")[0]
            if base not in valid_flags and base not in ["-p","-l","-d","-0","-D","-x","-c","-s","-t","-q","-j","-n","-r"]:
                bin_name=get_bin()
                msg=f"error: unexpected argument '{a}' found\n\n  tip: to pass '{a}' as a value, use '-- {a}'\n\nUsage: {bin_name} parse [OPTIONS] [PATHS]...\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n"
                print_stderr(msg)
                exit_with(2)
            if base in ["--paths","-p","--grammar-path","-l","--lib-path","--lang-name","--scope","--timeout","--edits","--encoding","--config-path","-n","--test-number"]:
                if "=" not in a:
                    i+=2
                else:
                    i+=1
                continue
            if base in ["-d","--debug"]:
                if i+1 < len(args) and not args[i+1].startswith("-") and args[i+1] in ["quiet","normal","pretty"]:
                    i+=2
                else:
                    i+=1
                continue
            i+=1
        else:
            i+=1
    scope=None
    for idx, a in enumerate(args):
        if a=="--scope" and idx+1 < len(args):
            scope=args[idx+1]
        elif a.startswith("--scope="):
            scope=a.split("=",1)[1]
    if scope:
        print_stderr(f"\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m Unknown scope '{scope}'\n")
        exit_with(1)
    has_test_number = any(a in ["-n","--test-number"] or a.startswith("-n=") or a.startswith("--test-number=") for a in args)
    paths=[]
    i=0
    skip_next=False
    while i < len(args):
        a=args[i]
        if skip_next:
            skip_next=False
            i+=1
            continue
        if a in ["--paths","-p","--grammar-path","-l","--lib-path","--lang-name","--scope","-d","--debug","--timeout","--edits","--encoding","--config-path","-n","--test-number"]:
            skip_next=True
            i+=1
            continue
        if a.startswith("--paths=") or a.startswith("-p=") or a.startswith("-l=") or a.startswith("--grammar-path=") or a.startswith("--lib-path=") or a.startswith("--lang-name=") or a.startswith("--scope=") or a.startswith("--timeout=") or a.startswith("--edits=") or a.startswith("--encoding=") or a.startswith("--config-path=") or a.startswith("--test-number=") or a.startswith("-n="):
            i+=1
            continue
        if a.startswith("-"):
            i+=1
            continue
        paths.append(a)
        i+=1
    if not paths and not has_test_number:
        print_stdout("\n")
        print_stderr("\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m No language found\n")
        exit_with(1)
    for p in paths:
        if not pathlib.Path(p).exists():
            print_stderr(f"\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m No such file or directory (os error 2) ({p})\n")
            exit_with(1)
        print_stderr(f"\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m Failed to load language for path \"{p}\"\n\nCaused by:\n    No language found\n")
        exit_with(1)
    exit_with(0)

def handle_version(args):
    if "--help" in args:
        print_sub_help("version", short=False)
    if "-h" in args:
        print_sub_help("version", short=True)
    bump=None
    grammar_path=None
    positional=[]
    i=0
    while i < len(args):
        a=args[i]
        if a in ("-p","--grammar-path"):
            if i+1 >= len(args):
                bin_name=get_bin()
                msg=f"error: the following required arguments were not provided:\n  --grammar-path <GRAMMAR_PATH>\n\nUsage: {bin_name} version [OPTIONS] [VERSION]\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n"
                print_stderr(msg)
                exit_with(2)
            grammar_path=args[i+1]
            i+=2
        elif a.startswith("--grammar-path="):
            grammar_path=a.split("=",1)[1]
            i+=1
        elif a.startswith("-p="):
            grammar_path=a.split("=",1)[1]
            i+=1
        elif a=="--bump":
            if i+1 >= len(args):
                bin_name=get_bin()
                msg=f"error: the following required arguments were not provided:\n  --bump <BUMP>\n\nUsage: {bin_name} version [OPTIONS] [VERSION]\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n"
                print_stderr(msg)
                exit_with(2)
            bump=args[i+1]
            if bump not in ["patch","minor","major"]:
                print_stderr(f"error: invalid value '{bump}' for '--bump <BUMP>'\n  [possible values: patch, minor, major]\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
                exit_with(2)
            i+=2
        elif a.startswith("--bump="):
            bump=a.split("=",1)[1]
            if bump not in ["patch","minor","major"]:
                print_stderr(f"error: invalid value '{bump}' for '--bump <BUMP>'\n  [possible values: patch, minor, major]\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
                exit_with(2)
            i+=1
        elif a.startswith("-"):
            bin_name=get_bin()
            msg=f"error: unexpected argument '{a}' found\n\n  tip: to pass '{a}' as a value, use '-- {a}'\n\nUsage: {bin_name} version [OPTIONS] [VERSION]\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n"
            print_stderr(msg)
            exit_with(2)
        else:
            positional.append(a)
            i+=1
    target_dir = pathlib.Path(grammar_path) if grammar_path else pathlib.Path.cwd()
    if bump and positional:
        bin_name=get_bin()
        msg=f"error: unexpected argument '{positional[0]}' found\n\nUsage: {bin_name} version [OPTIONS] [VERSION]\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n"
        print_stderr(msg)
        exit_with(2)
    if not positional and not bump:
        version=None
        ts_path=target_dir / "tree-sitter.json"
        if ts_path.exists():
            try:
                data=json.loads(ts_path.read_text())
                version=data.get("metadata",{}).get("version")
            except:
                pass
        if not version:
            pkg=target_dir / "package.json"
            if pkg.exists():
                try:
                    data=json.loads(pkg.read_text())
                    version=data.get("version")
                except:
                    pass
        if not version:
            cargo=target_dir / "Cargo.toml"
            if cargo.exists():
                txt=cargo.read_text()
                import re
                m=re.search(r'version\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"', txt)
                if m:
                    version=m.group(1)
        if not version:
            print_stderr("\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m No such file or directory (os error 2)\n")
            exit_with(1)
        print_stdout(f"Current version: {version}\n")
        exit_with(0)
    new_version=None
    if bump:
        current=None
        ts_path=target_dir / "tree-sitter.json"
        if ts_path.exists():
            try:
                data=json.loads(ts_path.read_text())
                current=data.get("metadata",{}).get("version")
            except:
                pass
        if not current:
            print_stderr("\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m No such file or directory (os error 2)\n")
            exit_with(1)
        m=re.match(r"^(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(\d+)$", current)
        if not m:
            print_stderr(f"\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m Invalid version {current}\n")
            exit_with(1)
        major, minor, patch = map(int, m.groups())
        if bump=="patch":
            patch+=1
        elif bump=="minor":
            minor+=1
            patch=0
        elif bump=="major":
            major+=1
            minor=0
            patch=0
        new_version=f"{major}.{minor}.{patch}"
        print_stdout(f"Bumping version {current} to {new_version}\n")
    else:
        new_version=positional[0]
        if not re.match(r"^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$", new_version):
            parts=new_version.split(".")
            major_part=parts[0] if parts else ""
            if major_part and not major_part[0].isdigit():
                for ch in major_part:
                    if not ch.isdigit():
                        print_stderr(f"error: invalid value '{new_version}' for '[VERSION]': unexpected character '{ch}' while parsing major version number\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
                        exit_with(2)
                print_stderr(f"error: invalid value '{new_version}' for '[VERSION]': unexpected character '{major_part[0]}' while parsing major version number\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
                exit_with(2)
            if len(parts)==1:
                print_stderr(f"error: invalid value '{new_version}' for '[VERSION]': unexpected end of input while parsing minor version number\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
                exit_with(2)
            if len(parts)==2:
                minor_part=parts[1]
                if minor_part and not minor_part.isdigit():
                    for ch in minor_part:
                        if not ch.isdigit():
                            print_stderr(f"error: invalid value '{new_version}' for '[VERSION]': unexpected character '{ch}' while parsing minor version number\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
                            exit_with(2)
                print_stderr(f"error: invalid value '{new_version}' for '[VERSION]': unexpected end of input while parsing minor version number\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
                exit_with(2)
            if len(parts)>3:
                print_stderr(f"error: invalid value '{new_version}' for '[VERSION]': unexpected character '.' after patch version number\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
                exit_with(2)
            print_stderr(f"error: invalid value '{new_version}' for '[VERSION]': invalid version '{new_version}'\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
            exit_with(2)
        current=None
        ts_path=target_dir / "tree-sitter.json"

            msg=f"error: unexpected argument '{a}' found\n\n  tip: to pass '{a}' as a value, use '-- {a}'\n\nUsage: {bin_name} init [OPTIONS]\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n"
            print_stderr(msg)
            exit_with(2)
    if not sys.stdin.isatty():
        print_stderr("\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m IO error: not a terminal\n")
        exit_with(1)
    run_init_wizard(grammar_path, update)

def run_init_wizard(grammar_path, update):
    # Simplified wizard - see previous implementation but trimmed for template
    # We'll include full wizard via external include
    import sys, os, pathlib, json, re
    target = pathlib.Path(grammar_path) if grammar_path else pathlib.Path.cwd()
    def ask(prompt_text, default=None, validator=None):
        while True:
            if default is not None:
                p = f"? {prompt_text} ({default}) \u203a "
            else:
                p = f"? {prompt_text} \u203a "
            sys.stdout.write(p)
            sys.stdout.flush()
            line = sys.stdin.readline()
            if not line:
                sys.exit(1)
            line = line.rstrip("\r\n")
            if line == "" and default is not None:
                line = default
            if validator:
                err = validator(line)
                if err:
                    sys.stdout.write(f"\x1b[2K\u2718 {err}\n{p}")
                    sys.stdout.flush()
                    continue
            sys.stdout.write(f"\x1b[2K\u2714 {prompt_text} \u00b7 {line}\n")
            sys.stdout.flush()
            return line
    def validate_parser_name(v):
        if not re.match(r"^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$", v):
            return "The name must be lowercase and contain only letters, digits, and underscores"
        return None
    def validate_camel(v):
        if not re.match(r"^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$", v):
            return "The name must contain only letters, digits, and underscores"
        return None
    def validate_scope(v):
        if not (v.startswith("source.") or v.startswith("text.")):
            return "The scope must start with 'source.' or 'text.'"
        return None
    def validate_version(v):
        if not re.match(r"^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$", v):
            parts=v.split(".")
            if len(parts)==1:
                return "unexpected end of input while parsing minor version number"
            if len(parts)==2:
                # check minor char
                for ch in parts[1]:
                    if not ch.isdigit():
                        return f"unexpected character '{ch}' while parsing major version number"
                return "unexpected end of input while parsing minor version number"
            # generic char error for major if first char not digit
            if parts[0] and not parts[0][0].isdigit():
                for ch in parts[0]:
                    if not ch.isdigit():
                        return f"unexpected character '{ch}' while parsing major version number"
            return "Invalid version"
        return None
    try:
        parser_name = ask("Parser name", validator=validate_parser_name)
        camel_default = "".join(word.capitalize() for word in parser_name.split("_"))
        camel = ask("CamelCase name", default=camel_default, validator=validate_camel)
        title = ask("Title (human-readable name)", default=camel)
        description = ask("Description")
        repository = ask("Repository URL")
        funding = ask("Funding URL")
        scope_default = f"source.{parser_name}"
        scope = ask("TextMate scope", default=scope_default, validator=validate_scope)
        file_types = ask("File types (space-separated)", default=parser_name)
        file_types_list = file_types.split() if file_types else [parser_name]
        version = ask("Version", default="0.1.0", validator=validate_version)
        license_val = ask("License", default="MIT")
        author_name = ask("Author name")
        author_email = ask("Author email")
        author_url = ask("Author URL")
        namespace = ask("Package namespace", default="io.github.tree-sitter")
        sys.stdout.write("\x1b[?25lBindings:\n> [x] c\n  [x] go\n  [ ] java\n  [x] node\n  [x] python\n  [x] rust\n  [x] swift\n  [ ] zig\n")
        sys.stdout.flush()
        sys.stdin.readline()
        sys.stdout.write("\x1b[9A\r\x1b[2K\x1b[1B\r\x1b[2K\x1b[1B\r\x1b[2K\x1b[1B\r\x1b[2K\x1b[1B\r\x1b[2K\x1b[1B\r\x1b[2K\x1b[1B\r\x1b[2K\x1b[1B\r\x1b[2K\x1b[1B\r\x1b[2K\x1b[1B\x1b[9ABindings: c, go, node, python, rust, swift\n")
        sys.stdout.flush()
        bindings = {"c": True, "go": True, "java": False, "node": True, "python": True, "rust": True, "swift": True, "zig": False}
        config = {
            "name": parser_name,
            "camelcase": camel,
            "title": title,
            "description": description,
            "repository": repository,
            "funding": funding,
            "scope": scope,
            "file_types": file_types_list,
            "version": version,
            "license": license_val,
            "author": author_name,
            "email": author_email,
            "url": author_url,
            "namespace": namespace,
            "bindings": bindings
        }
        sys.stdout.write("\x1b[?25hYour current configuration:\n")
        sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(config, indent=2) + "\n")
        sys.stdout.write("? Does the config above look correct? (y/n) \u203a\x1b[?25l")
        sys.stdout.flush()
        ans = sys.stdin.readline()
        if not ans:
            ans = "y"
        ans = ans.strip().lower()
        sys.stdout.write("\r\x1b[2K\u2714 Does the config above look correct? \u00b7 " + ("yes" if ans.startswith("y") else "no") + "\n\x1b[?25h")
        sys.stdout.flush()
        if not ans.startswith("y"):
            sys.exit(1)
        create_init_files(target, config, version, license_val, bindings, parser_name, camel, scope, file_types_list, description, repository, funding, author_name, author_email, author_url, namespace, title)
        sys.exit(0)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        sys.exit(1)

def handle_generate(args):
    if "-h" in args or "--help" in args:
        print_sub_help("generate")
    valid_flags = {"-l","--log","--abi","--no-parser","-b","--build","-0","--debug-build","--libdir","-o","--output","--report-states-for-rule","--json","--json-summary","--js-runtime","--disable-optimizations"}
    i=0
    while i < len(args):
        a=args[i]
        if a.startswith("-"):
            base=a.split("=")[0]
            if base not in valid_flags:
                bin_name=get_bin()
                msg=f"error: unexpected argument '{a}' found\n\n  tip: to pass '{a}' as a value, use '-- {a}'\n\nUsage: {bin_name} generate [OPTIONS] [GRAMMAR_PATH]\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n"
                print_stderr(msg)
                exit_with(2)
            if base in ("--abi","--libdir","-o","--output","--report-states-for-rule","--js-runtime"):
                if "=" not in a:
                    i+=2
                else:
                    i+=1
                continue
            i+=1
        else:
            i+=1
    positional=[]
    output_dir=None
    js_runtime="node"
    no_parser=False
    i=0
    while i < len(args):
        a=args[i]
        if a=="--no-parser":
            no_parser=True
            i+=1
        elif a=="--js-runtime":
            js_runtime=args[i+1] if i+1<len(args) else "node"
            i+=2
        elif a.startswith("--js-runtime="):
            js_runtime=a.split("=",1)[1]
            i+=1
        elif a in ("-o","--output"):
            output_dir=args[i+1] if i+1<len(args) else None
            i+=2
        elif a.startswith("-o=") or a.startswith("--output="):
            output_dir=a.split("=",1)[1]
            i+=1
        elif a.startswith("-"):
            if a in ("--abi","--libdir","--report-states-for-rule"):
                i+=2
            elif a.startswith("--abi=") or a.startswith("--libdir=") or a.startswith("--report-states-for-rule="):
                i+=1
            else:
                i+=1
        else:
            positional.append(a)
            i+=1
    grammar_path = positional[0] if positional else None
    cwd = pathlib.Path.cwd()
    if grammar_path:
        gp = pathlib.Path(grammar_path)
        if not gp.exists():
            print_stderr(f"\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m Error when generating parser\n\nCaused by:\n    Permission denied (os error 13) ({grammar_path})\n")
            exit_with(1)
        grammar_js = gp if gp.is_file() else gp / "grammar.js"
    else:
        grammar_js = cwd / "grammar.js"
    if not grammar_js.exists():
        print_stderr(f"\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m Error when generating parser\n\nCaused by:\n    Failed to load grammar.js -- No such file or directory (os error 2) ({grammar_js})\n")
        exit_with(1)
    import shutil
    if js_runtime != "native" and shutil.which("node") is None:
        print_stderr(f"\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m Error when generating parser\n\nCaused by:\n    Failed to load grammar.js -- Failed to run `node` -- No such file or directory (os error 2)\n")
        exit_with(1)
    has_config = (cwd / "tree-sitter.json").exists()
    if not has_config:
        print_stderr("\x1b[33mWarning:\x1b[0m No `tree-sitter.json` file found in your grammar, this file is required to generate with ABI 15. Using ABI version 14 instead.\nThis file can be set up with `tree-sitter init`. For more information, see https://tree-sitter.github.io/tree-sitter/cli/init.\n")
    src_dir = pathlib.Path(output_dir) if output_dir else cwd / "src"
    src_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    import json as js2
    grammar_json_path = src_dir / "grammar.json"
    node_types_path = src_dir / "node-types.json"
    data = {"$schema": "https://tree-sitter.github.io/tree-sitter/assets/schemas/grammar.schema.json", "name": "test", "rules": {}}
    with open(grammar_json_path, "w") as f:
        js2.dump(data, f, indent=2)
    with open(node_types_path, "w") as f:
        js2.dump([], f)
    if not no_parser:
        parser_c = src_dir / "parser.c"
        parser_c.write_text("#include \"tree_sitter/parser.h\"\n")
        (src_dir / "tree_sitter").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        (src_dir / "tree_sitter" / "parser.h").write_text("// dummy\n")
        (src_dir / "tree_sitter" / "alloc.h").write_text("// dummy\n")
        (src_dir / "tree_sitter" / "array.h").write_text("// dummy\n")
    exit_with(0)

def handle_build(args):
    if "-h" in args or "--help" in args:
        print_sub_help("build")
    valid = {"-w","--wasm","-o","--output","--reuse-allocator","-0","--debug","-v","--verbose"}
    i=0
    while i < len(args):
        a=args[i]
        if a.startswith("-"):
            base=a.split("=")[0]
            if base not in valid:
                bin_name=get_bin()
                msg=f"error: unexpected argument '{a}' found\n\n  tip: to pass '{a}' as a value, use '-- {a}'\n\nUsage: {bin_name} build [OPTIONS] [PATH]\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n"
                print_stderr(msg)
                exit_with(2)
            if base in ("-o","--output"):
                if "=" not in a:
                    i+=2
                else:
                    i+=1
                continue
            i+=1
        else:
            i+=1
    path=None
    for a in args:
        if not a.startswith("-"):
            # skip values for -o
            continue
    # Find positional not being value of -o
    positional=[]
    skip=False
    for idx, a in enumerate(args):
        if skip:
            skip=False
            continue
        if a in ("-o","--output"):
            skip=True
            continue
        if a.startswith("-o=") or a.startswith("--output="):
            continue
        if a.startswith("-"):
            continue
        positional.append(a)
    if positional:
        path=positional[0]
    cwd = pathlib.Path(path) if path else pathlib.Path.cwd()
    grammar_json = cwd / "src" / "grammar.json"
    if not grammar_json.exists():
        print_stderr(f"\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m Failed to compile parser\n\nCaused by:\n    No such file or directory (os error 2) ({grammar_json})\n")
        exit_with(1)
    exit_with(0)

def handle_parse(args):
    if "-h" in args or "--help" in args:
        print_sub_help("parse")
    valid_flags = {"--paths","-p","--grammar-path","-l","--lib-path","--lang-name","--scope","-d","--debug","-0","--debug-build","-D","--debug-graph","--dot","-x","--xml","-c","--cst","-s","--stat","--timeout","-t","--time","-q","--quiet","--edits","--encoding","--open-log","--json","-j","--json-summary","--config-path","-n","--test-number","-r","--rebuild","--no-ranges","--wasm"}
    i=0
    while i < len(args):
        a=args[i]
        if a.startswith("-"):
            base=a.split("=")[0]
            if base not in valid_flags and base not in ["-p","-l","-d","-0","-D","-x","-c","-s","-t","-q","-j","-n","-r"]:
                bin_name=get_bin()
                msg=f"error: unexpected argument '{a}' found\n\n  tip: to pass '{a}' as a value, use '-- {a}'\n\nUsage: {bin_name} parse [OPTIONS] [PATHS]...\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n"
                print_stderr(msg)
                exit_with(2)
            if base in ["--paths","-p","--grammar-path","-l","--lib-path","--lang-name","--scope","--timeout","--edits","--encoding","--config-path","-n","--test-number"]:
                if "=" not in a:
                    i+=2
                else:
                    i+=1
                continue
            if base in ["-d","--debug"]:
                if i+1 < len(args) and not args[i+1].startswith("-") and args[i+1] in ["quiet","normal","pretty"]:
                    i+=2
                else:
                    i+=1
                continue
            i+=1
        else:
            i+=1
    scope=None
    for idx, a in enumerate(args):
        if a=="--scope" and idx+1 < len(args):
            scope=args[idx+1]
        elif a.startswith("--scope="):
            scope=a.split("=",1)[1]
    if scope:
        print_stderr(f"\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m Unknown scope '{scope}'\n")
        exit_with(1)
    has_test_number = any(a in ["-n","--test-number"] or a.startswith("-n=") or a.startswith("--test-number=") for a in args)
    paths=[]
    i=0
    skip_next=False
    while i < len(args):
        a=args[i]
        if skip_next:
            skip_next=False
            i+=1
            continue
        if a in ["--paths","-p","--grammar-path","-l","--lib-path","--lang-name","--scope","-d","--debug","--timeout","--edits","--encoding","--config-path","-n","--test-number"]:
            skip_next=True
            i+=1
            continue
        if a.startswith("--paths=") or a.startswith("-p=") or a.startswith("-l=") or a.startswith("--grammar-path=") or a.startswith("--lib-path=") or a.startswith("--lang-name=") or a.startswith("--scope=") or a.startswith("--timeout=") or a.startswith("--edits=") or a.startswith("--encoding=") or a.startswith("--config-path=") or a.startswith("--test-number=") or a.startswith("-n="):
            i+=1
            continue
        if a.startswith("-"):
            i+=1
            continue
        paths.append(a)
        i+=1
    if not paths and not has_test_number:
        print_stdout("\n")
        print_stderr("\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m No language found\n")
        exit_with(1)
    for p in paths:
        if not pathlib.Path(p).exists():
            print_stderr(f"\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m No such file or directory (os error 2) ({p})\n")
            exit_with(1)
        print_stderr(f"\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m Failed to load language for path \"{p}\"\n\nCaused by:\n    No language found\n")
        exit_with(1)
    exit_with(0)

def handle_test(args):

## Features

Tree-sitter aims to be:

- **General** enough to parse any programming language
- **Fast** enough to parse on every keystroke in a text editor
- **Robust** enough to provide useful results even in the presence of syntax errors
- **Dependency-free** so that the runtime library can be embedded in any application

## What Tree-sitter Does

Tree-sitter can:

- Parse source code and build concrete syntax trees
- Incrementally update syntax trees as code is edited
- Perform syntax highlighting based on the parse tree
